media_assets_lease_attempt.name: media_assets_lease_attempt
media_assets_lease_attempt.value: "media_assets"."lease_until" is null or "media_assets"."attempt_id" is not null

opening_hours_state_consistent.name: opening_hours_state_consistent
opening_hours_state_consistent.value: ("opening_hours"."status" = 'open' and "opening_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "opening_hours"."closes_at" is not null) or ("opening_hours"."status" in ('unknown','closed') and "opening_hours"."opens_at" is null and "opening_hours"."closes_at" is null and not "opening_hours"."closes_next_day")

opening_hours_minute_precision.name: opening_hours_minute_precision
opening_hours_minute_precision.value: extract(second from "opening_hours"."opens_at") = 0 and extract(second from "opening_hours"."closes_at") = 0 and "opening_hours"."opens_at" < time '24:00' and "opening_hours"."closes_at" < time '24:00'

opening_hours_duration.name: opening_hours_duration
opening_hours_duration.value: "opening_hours"."status" <> 'open' or (("opening_hours"."closes_at" - "opening_hours"."opens_at") + case when "opening_hours"."closes_next_day" then interval '24 hours' else interval '0 hours' end > interval '0 hours' and ("opening_hours"."closes_at" - "opening_hours"."opens_at") + case when "opening_hours"."closes_next_day" then interval '24 hours' else interval '0 hours' end <= interval '24 hours')
